title: The Support Buddy X9000 — Agentic Support Engineering Platform
description: An agentic support engineering platform that investigates tickets, gathers evidence, identifies root causes, and—with human approval—hands validated issues to an autonomous coding workflow for reproduction, testing, fixes, and pull requests.
highlights: 9-node LangGraph investigation pipeline with parallel evidence gathering, RAG knowledge search, and root-cause ranking.
Devin AI integration for autonomous bug reproduction, code fixes, and pull-request generation—gated by human-in-the-loop approval.
Inngest-driven async orchestration with GitHub issue sync, incident clustering, and full agent execution audit trail.

title: AI Support Engineer — AI-Powered Customer Support Copilot
description: An AI-powered support copilot that layers on top of a customer support CRM. Support agents can analyze tickets, surface similar resolved cases, generate multi-tone reply drafts, and ask free-form questions — all powered by OpenAI with async job execution and live status updates.
highlights: Ticket analysis extracts signals, hypotheses, and clarifying questions via GPT-4o-mini.
Vector search with pgvector (HNSW indexing) surfaces similar resolved cases in real time.
Multi-tone draft generation (Professional, Friendly, Concise, Surfer), RAG knowledge base pipeline, PII redaction, and full audit trail.

title: Inside the LLM — Interactive LLM Inference Visualization
description: An interactive visualization that walks users through the major stages of LLM inference—from tokenization and embeddings through attention, transformer processing, sampling, generation, context windows, and RAG—with real GPT tokenization and honest labeling of simulated vs. real computation.
highlights: 11-stage pipeline covering tokenization, embeddings, positional encoding, attention, transformer layers, prediction, sampling, generation, context windows, and RAG.
D3-powered interactive visualizations including attention heatmaps and embedding scatterplots, with beginner and technical explanation modes.
Runs entirely in the browser with no API calls; provider pattern enables real model backends without UI changes.

title: KoeJLPT — Voice-First JLPT Preparation App
description: A voice-first Japanese Language Proficiency Test preparation app. Level-based vocabulary study, real-time WebRTC AI voice conversations exclusively in Japanese, and automatic pronunciation grading via Google Cloud Speech-to-Text.
highlights: Real-time WebRTC voice conversations with AI partner Fumi — all in Japanese — powered by ElevenLabs.
Three pronunciation practice modes with automatic grading via Google Cloud Speech-to-Text.
Level-based vocabulary study (N5–N1) with audio playback, save functionality, and persistent study streak tracking.

title: AI Coding Tutor — Interactive AI-Powered Coding Challenge System
description: An intelligent, web-based educational platform that teaches web development fundamentals through hands-on coding challenges. Students write real code in a browser-based Monaco editor, get instant automated feedback, and receive personalized guidance from an AI tutor powered by Claude 3.5.
highlights: 240 progressive coding challenges across HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Full Stack — with 160 enhanced variants featuring three-tier hints and multiple solutions.
AI-powered adaptive tutor (Claude 3.5 Haiku & Sonnet) provides contextual help, explanations, and personalized guidance based on student code.
Monaco Editor (VS Code engine) with live preview, solution locking after 3 attempts, and AI-generated themed challenge variants.

title: The Udemy Course Compress-a-macator 5000
description: A TypeScript/Node.js tool that compresses Udemy courses into AI-generated study plans. Requires an active Udemy login and purchased access to the course being scraped — Playwright uses your existing session to extract transcripts, then Claude ranks each lesson as build / watch / skim / skip and reorders them into an optimal path.
highlights: Playwright drives a persistent Chromium session to extract transcripts from all course lectures.
Claude AI (Haiku + Sonnet) classifies each lesson as build/watch/skim/skip and generates an optimized study plan.
Dual interface: React/Vite web UI at localhost:5173 and a CLI — both backed by an Express API.
